definitions.explanation: a gathering where each person brings food or drinks to share
the act of everyone contributing something (money, ideas, items) to a common pool

examples.japanese: {持|も}ち{寄|よ}りパーティーをしよう。
{今日|きょう}は{一品|いっぴん}{持|も}ち{寄|よ}りです。
{会議|かいぎ}ではアイデアの{持|も}ち{寄|よ}りが{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: In meetings, everyone contributing their own ideas is important.

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
{持|も}つ (to hold, bring) + {寄|よ}る (to gather)
Literally "bringing and gathering."

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {持|も}ち{寄|よ}りパーティー - potluck party
- {一品|いっぴん}{持|も}ち{寄|よ}り - each person brings one dish
- {持|も}ち{寄|よ}りで - in potluck style
- アイデアを{持|も}ち{寄|よ}る - to bring ideas together
- {情報|じょうほう}を{持|も}ち{寄|よ}る - to pool information

FORMS:
{持|も}ち{寄|よ}る - to bring together, to pool

RELATED WORDS:
- {寄|よ}せ{集|あつ}め - collection, hodgepodge
- {出|だ}し{合|あ}う - to pool (money, resources)
